d.ko: A Brazilian top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and Chinatown Wars. Steal cars, turn intersections into police pileups and switch between two protagonists. Take jobs, race illegally or grab a helicopter and explore a freshly generated island.
